items.t: Symptoms of gastro-oesophageal reflux such as acid regurgitation, heartburn and indigestion, including after meals and in pregnancy.

Treatment of symptoms of gastro-oesophageal reflux such as acid regurgitation, heartburn and indigestion (related to reflux)

items.t: Double-strength products also: symptoms of excess stomach acid (hyperacidity), and reflux symptoms during or after stopping acid-suppressing therapy.

src.q: for symptoms of excess stomach acid (hyperacidity)
Can also be used to treat the symptoms of gastro-oesophageal reflux during concomitant treatment with or following withdrawal of acid suppressing therapy.

items.t: High in sodium: double-strength suspension 127.88 mg per 10 ml; standard suspension 285.2 mg (12.4 mmol) per 20 ml; double-strength tablets 223.56 mg (9.72 mmol) per 4 tablets; standard tablets 235 mg (11 mmol) per 4 tablets. Take into account on a low-salt diet (e.g. some cases of congestive heart failure and renal impairment).

This medicinal product contains 285.2 mg (12.4 mmol) sodium per 20 ml dose

items.t: Calcium: double-strength suspension 260 mg (6.5 mmol) calcium per 20 ml; double-strength tablets 300 mg (7.5 mmol) calcium per 4 tablets; standard suspension 160 mg calcium carbonate per 10 ml; standard tablets 320 mg calcium carbonate per 4 tablets. Take care in hypercalcaemia, nephrocalcinosis and recurrent calcium-containing renal stones.

items.t: Seek medical advice if symptoms persist or treatment is needed for more than 7 days (double-strength); review if no improvement after 7 days (standard). Antacids can mask symptoms of more serious underlying conditions.

src.q: If symptoms persist, or treatment is required for more than 7 days continuously, medical advice should be sought.
If symptoms do not improve after 7 days, the clinical situation should be reviewed.

items.t: Phenylketonuria (tablets contain aspartame): standard tablets should not be given; double-strength tablets may be harmful.

src.q: Due to its aspartame content this product should not be given to patients with phenylketonuria.

items.t: Suspensions contain parahydroxybenzoates; double-strength tablets contain carmoisine (E122). Both may cause allergic reactions.

src.q: which may cause allergic reactions (possibly delayed)
This medicine contains Carmoisine lake (E122). This may cause allergic reactions.

items.t: Leave 2 hours between this product and other medicines, especially tetracyclines, fluoroquinolones, iron salts, thyroid hormones (levothyroxine), beta-blockers (atenolol, metoprolol, propranolol), glucocorticoids, chloroquine, bisphosphonates, digoxin, ketoconazole, neuroleptics, penicillamine and estramustine (double-strength SmPCs also list H2-antihistamines).
